description: This Java source file defines utility methods for handling LwM2mObject models, including parsing resource data into ObjectModel instances and converting them into LwM2mObject representations, with error handling and logging.

classes.name: LwM2mObjectModelUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing methods to parse and convert LwM2m resource data into model objects.

methods.name: toLwm2mResource
methods.description: Parses a TbResource to extract ObjectModel data, sets resource keys and search text, and converts to LwM2mObject if applicable.
